subject: Dedicated commit sizing for Nebula — inventory rebalance plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@nebulaai.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Sizing ask — Nebula deal closes July; need reserve recommendation

Hannah / Laura —

Quick context: Nebula is targeting a July 15 close for a Dedicated contract (~12m USD over 12 months) and wants an initial committed pool to support their pilot + 2 prod clusters. Sarah looped me in to confirm run-rate and any stretch/burst guidance.

Can infra and finance weigh in on the minimal committed GPU footprint we should propose (and recommended buffer for burst/beta)? High-level ask: what committed size we can safely promise without excessive slack but still hit their SLAs.

Notes to consider:
- Nebula pilot starts 7/20 with 2 LLM endpoints (avg seq length 1k, expected peak 60 qps across endpoints).
- Long-tail usage spikes during batch scoring windows (nightly).
- They're open to a 60-day commit ramp if that helps smooth inventory booking.

Laura — can you confirm pricing/discount bands for a 6mo vs 12mo reserve?
Karthik / Ben — what does the fleet look like in July for new Dedicated allocations? Any constraints on Proxmox zones we should avoid?

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@nebulaai.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sizing ask — Nebula deal closes July; need reserve recommendation

Thanks Jordan — quick finance notes: 

- Pricing tiers: 6mo commit gets ~7% off list; 12mo commit ~12% off. We can add a one-time onboarding credit up to $25k for pilot acceptance criteria if needed.
- For a 12m ARR ask, we'll want to map committed GPU months to expected token / QPS to ensure unit economics remain positive.
- If we propose a 60-day ramp (50% first 30 days, 85% by day 60), we can soften up-front capex and still sell a 12mo contract.

I'll attach a quick model after I sync with infra on how many GPUs translate to their expected qps/seq.

-Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Customer Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@nebulaai.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sizing ask — Nebula deal closes July; need reserve recommendation

Quick infra readout: 

High level capacity and constraints for July/August:
- Current GPU pool: 320 T4-equivalent slots (mix of A10G and A100-20).
- Committed capacity already promised for July: ~230 slots (across existing Dedicated deals + internal experiments).
- Available uncommitted: ~90 slots, but we need to keep a safety buffer of 15-20 slots for emergent enterprise escalations.

For Nebula's profile (60 qps across 1k seq, conservative coef):
- Pilot (2 endpoints): estimated steady-state ~24 slots if we optimize batching + KV cache aggressively.
- Production (2 clusters): peak headroom for bursts could require an additional 28 slots (total 52).

Recommendation:
- Propose an initial committed pool of 48 GPUs with a 60-day ramp (25% active first 14 days, 60% by day 30, 100% by day 60).
- Offer defined burst credits for short spikes (up to 12 slots) billed at on-demand uplift.

Caveats:
- If Nebula requires strict cross-region redundancy, we will need to reserve additional slots in the EU/US zonal split (adds +8 slots).
- Late network maintenance scheduled for 7/10 in zone-a may reduce burst capacity for a 24-36 hour window.

I'll put numbers into the sizing workbook and share.

—Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Capacity
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@nebulaai.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sizing ask — Nebula deal closes July; need reserve recommendation

Thanks everyone — consolidated plan below and next steps. Attaching: nebula-dedicated-sizing.xlsx (workbook) and runbook-reserve-rebalance.md (short ops runbook).

Consolidated recommendation:
- Commit: 48 GPUs (A10G-equivalent), 12-month term with 60-day ramp.
- Burst: 12-slot burst credit pool billed at +40% on-demand rate for usage beyond committed baseline.
- SLA notes: include a clause for scheduled maintenance windows and an explicit fallback to hosted-region variants if cross-region capacity shortfalls occur.
- Discount: 12mo -> 12% off list; onboarding credit: $20k tied to pilot acceptance.

Action items (owners):
- Jordan: land the 60-day ramp language with the customer and confirm cross-region/DR needs (due 6/24).
- Karthik: finalize the gating thresholds and update the allocation plan in the workbook (due 6/24).
- Laura: finalize pricing lines and create the contract stub with clear burst pricing (due 6/24).
- Ben: prepare a short ops checklist for onboarding and capacity switchovers (due 6/30).

Sarah — please confirm whether Nebula can accept ramped commits (they indicated yes in demo but want explicit language). Also flag any procurement timelines.

Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Sales Ops Manager 
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@nebulaai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nebulaai.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sizing ask — Nebula deal closes July; need reserve recommendation

Thanks — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed internally. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- Ramp: Nebula accepts the 60-day ramp and will sign the amended commitment language.
- Cross-region: initially US-only, but we want option to add EU zones within the first 90 days (we'll provide a formal request through the contract amendment).
- Billing: procurement prefers monthly invoicing against the committed baseline with overage charges quarterly; that's negotiable.

I'll loop procurement into doc review today. Jordan — can you send the contract stub and the workbook to procurement@nebulaai.com?

Sarah

--
Sarah Lin
Head of Platform Engineering
Nebula AI
